bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · reclaimed the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 收复 100 日均线

read.en: TSMC rose 1.6% on Oct 21 to $431.89, trading between $423.74 and $435.16. It is above the falling 5-day ($422.4), rising 100-day ($430.3) and rising 200-day ($396.7) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($434.3) and falling 30-day ($443.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($447.29), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 台积电 10月21日上涨 1.6%，收于 $431.89，盘中区间 $423.74–435.16。股价位于下行的 5 日（$422.4）、上行的 100 日（$430.3）和上行的 200 日均线（$396.7）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$434.3）和下行的 30 日均线（$443.4）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$447.29），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $430 100-day average, which now becomes support, but the high stalled near the 10-day. Resistance is $435 (10-day, day's high), then $444 (30-day, Sep 8 high) and $447.3 (SAR). Support is $430, then $422.4 (5-day) and $412.5 (Sep 15 low). A close above $435 would target $444; a close below $422 would reopen $412.5.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $430 的 100 日均线，该位置转为支撑，但盘中高点在 10 日均线附近受阻。阻力为 $435（10 日均线、当日高点），其次 $444（30 日均线、9月8日高点）和 $447.3（SAR）。支撑为 $430，其次 $422.4（5 日均线）和 $412.5（9月15日低点）。若收盘站上 $435，下一目标看 $444；若收盘跌破 $422，将重新打开 $412.5。
